response.consequence: Admins see a phantom empty last page in the group member list, and the group members page shares the same model. The off-by-one lives in the new pagination logic (group.js offset clamp together with the totalPages formula in admin-group.js.es6).
response.explanation: findMembers clamps the offset to user_count, not to the last valid page start. The admin-group controller computes totalPages as floor(user_count/limit)+1 and the group.js clamp uses the same boundary. With 50 members and limit 50, totalPages is 2, so "next" is enabled on page 1. Next sets offset = min(0+50, 50) = 50, and the server then returns an empty members list for offset 50. The UI shows page 2/2 with no members. The same happens for any count that is an exact multiple of the limit.

response.consequence: No user-visible defect found in this change.
response.explanation: Group.findMembers (models/group.js:20-38) replaces `members` wholesale with the server result on each call and clamps the offset against user_count. It never appends, so repeated calls from setupController cannot produce duplicates. The route sets the controller model to the group and the template iterates `members` on it, so the new code is consistent. The old code was worse: `findMembers().then` resolved to undefined, so `_members` was undefined and the controller model was set to undefined.

The lookup uses modelFor('adminGroups'), the parent route's model, which is resolved before the child model hook runs. The model hook was not part of the change. I did not inspect the router map or serialize behavior. The hypothesis about redirects on direct loads is not supported by the code I read.

response.consequence: Admins see a spurious empty page and an enabled "next" button for any group whose member count is a non-zero multiple of the page size (50, 100, and so on).
response.explanation: In admin-group.js.es6, `totalPages` is computed as `Math.floor(user_count / limit) + 1`. For a group with exactly 50 members and limit 50, this gives 2 pages instead of 1. `showingLast` compares `currentPage` with `totalPages`, so on page 1 it is false and `next` is allowed. `next` then sets offset = min(0+50, 50) = 50. `findMembers` requests offset 50 and gets an empty member list, so the admin lands on a blank page 2.
